claim_boundary: Openverse results are strong-query context candidates, not pixel-reviewed weapon, action, athlete, bout, touch, or skill labels. Openverse itself warns that indexed license metadata may be inaccurate, so every row retains its upstream landing page, creator, attribution, and license statement. Wikimedia is excluded because the controlled Commons source is audited separately. Exact duplicate bytes are eligible only once, and creator-level groups must stay intact in evaluation.
